correction: A prune of the changes log deletes only a seq prefix: the age rule deletes up to the newest event recorded before the cutoff, never by the time column alone, because the wall clock can go back and events.subscribe detects a pruned replay only by the oldest retained seq.
evidence: frostnotes#236: the cross-review at cf96312 found that `DELETE ... WHERE at < ?` could delete seq 2 and keep seqs 1 and 3 when the clock went back, so a subscriber from seq 1 got a replay with a gap and no resync; store.TestPruneChangesByAgeLeavesNoGap guards the fix
